scope: Distinct durable void queue/refund receipt proofs and outbound recovery.

decisions.authority: New queue authorizations still require the live fenced canonical writer and both financial roles. Previously authenticated void completion uses its confirmed original queue and immutable onchain right; no financial writer, new financial role signatures, expiry extension or current financial generation is required.
decisions.queue_is_unpaid: Queue proof persists the obligation while original stake and underwriting remain reserved. Transaction claim/lane is released only atomically with that proof.
decisions.completion_is_custody_credit: Completion proof recognizes the original stake credited once to the original owner in custody. It does not assert a physical customer USDC withdrawal.
decisions.historical_signed_call: Queue events lack a digest/evidence marker, so reconciliation additionally verifies exact actual transaction calldata, chain, target, zero value and transaction hash. Successful execution through pinned immutable custody code proves authorization at inclusion; current roles need not validate historical signatures after rotation.
decisions.later_source_prefix: The original signed evidence is retained. A later prefix may have a new journal/oracle commitment, but every final-decision field including owner, stake, canonical/observed time and original acceptance commitment must agree.
decisions.durability: Queue proof/right and terminal processing state commit together. Completion proof, paid right and terminal processing state commit together. A forced terminal-write failure rolled all completion writes back.
decisions.nonce_recovery: The existing dedicated-payer raw-transaction lane remains in force for queue and completion; no new nonce is assigned on an uncertain send.
decisions.completion_identity: No financial generation participates in completion intent identity. Resume remains stable through signer rotation; its old plan deadline is not an expiry of the recorded right.
decisions.historical_generation: Actual transaction generation is now derived from pre/post-block AccessController version and all ordered SignerRotated events, excluding rotations after the direct queue transaction. False self-consistent historical generation metadata is rejected.

executed_checks: three shared-engine outcomes and existing cash-batch failures/recovery retained
queue and refund lost replies followed by PostgreSQL restart
queue credit remains zero and exposure/stake remain locked
actual queue calldata differs from self-consistent asserted authorization: rejected
modified queue/refund events, refund owner and unexpected pool transfer: rejected
raw/restored proof cannot bypass fresh receipt verification
later native journal prefix preserves the original queue proof
financial writer connection actually closed before completion
betting paused, signer rotated again and 601 seconds passed after raw completion preparation
completion requires no new financial signatures and credits exact original stake once
terminal refund-write failure rolls back proof and paid right while retaining original queue
completed retries neither broadcast nor readmit the refunded right
unit receipt tests reject missing/duplicate outcomes, changed time/PnL/ticket, removed/replaced/nil logs and pool movement
assumptions: Pinned immutable contracts and authenticated honest canonical RPC views.
PostgreSQL durability and a dedicated payer; injected transaction signer never broadcasts.
Synthetic gas/fee values and confirmation depth are not production calibration.
remaining: approved production fee and recovery policy
